patch.value: GH-770: pending merge receipts remain invisible to validation and CI before reconciliation

A clone-local pending merge receipt can contain a discarded peer value while pm validate remains ok:true and names no receipt, so the natural CI gate can approve an unresolved data-loss decision before pm merge reconcile persists it.

Pending merge receipts are a machine-enforced validation or standalone strict gate; the diagnostic names the affected item and fields without leaking private content by default; item-merge guidance routes agents to reconcile before commit; sandboxed two-branch and CI acceptance tests prove the unresolved state cannot pass.
pm 2026.7.27 on Linux with installed merge drivers
Create divergent item edits, merge, commit the resolved item without pm merge reconcile, then compare pm merge report --json with pm validate --json.
Validation or a dedicated strict gate fails while any merge receipt remains pending and provides actionable receipt context.
pm merge report shows a pending receipt with the discarded value while pm validate remains ok:true and does not mention receipts.
